create_NCE_loss: create an NCE loss instance that computes contrastive loss from alignment scores
create_T2VContraLoss: create a text-to-video contrastive loss that computes softmax on the text2video matrix
create_V2TContraLoss: create a video-to-text contrastive loss that computes softmax on the video2text matrix
create_MMContraLoss: create a multimodal contrastive loss that computes symmetric video and text losses
create_MTM_loss: create a combined masked task model loss for video logits and text logits
